mapper.select: SELECT a.*, c.name AS category_name, f.original_name AS cover_file_name, t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name, t.color AS tag_color FROM blog_article a LEFT JOIN blog_category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN blog_file f ON f.id = a.cover_file_id LEFT JOIN blog_article_tag at ON at.article_id = a.id LEFT JOIN blog_tag t ON t.id = at.tag_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
